entities.summary: Gopal Krishna Gokhale was an Indian political leader and a social reformer during the Indian independence movement, and political mentor of Indian freedom fighter Mahatma Gandhi. Gokhale was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and the founder of the Servants of India Society. Through the Society as well as the Congress and other legislative bodies he served in, Gokhale campaigned for Indian self-rule and social reforms. He was the leader of the moderate faction of the Congress that advocated reforms by working with existing government institutions, and a major member of the Poona Association or the Poona Sarvajanik Sabha.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Gokhale's leadership in the Indian National Congress and his advocacy for social reforms had a significant impact on the Indian independence movement, influencing Mahatma Gandhi and shaping the country's path towards self-rule. His efforts contributed to the eventual passage of the Government of India Act 1935.
